items.title: Drone debris reportedly causes fire at Kyiv residential building
items.summary: A report said falling drone debris caused a fire on a lower floor of a residential building in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district. No casualty information was provided in the report.

items.title: Temporary airport restrictions reported in Samara and Ulyanovsk
items.summary: Russian military reporting described temporary airport restrictions in Samara and Ulyanovsk amid alleged Ukrainian drone activity.

items.title: Russian sources allege Ukraine is considering tighter mobilization rules
items.summary: Unnamed Russian security sources claimed Ukrainian recruitment officials could receive expanded powers. The report did not provide confirmation from Ukrainian authorities.

items.title: Russian strikes reported near Artsyz in Odesa region
items.summary: A Russian military correspondent reported airstrikes near Artsyz and described damage and a fire. The nature of the targets and extent of damage were not established in the report.
